title: Parameters for DNF approximation
statement: There is a constant $C>0$ such that for every positive integer $w$ and every real number $psilon$ with $0<psilon\le 1/2$, there is a natural number $t$ for which $8(1/2)^t\lepsilon$ and $\frac{(2w)^3}{psilon^2}9^{120w(t+1)}\le(1/psilon)^{Cw}$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a positive real constant $C$.
There exists a natural number $t$ satisfying both displayed inequalities.
replaced: There exists an absolute $C>0$ such that for every positive integer $w$ and $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$, there exists $t\in\mathbb N$ satisfying $8\,2^{-t}\le\varepsilon$ and $((2w)^3/\varepsilon^2)9^{120w(t+1)}\le(1/\varepsilon)^{Cw}$.
